result.notes: A developer can self-serve create an app and get OAuth access tokens for free to test against their own ad account (Standard Access, no review needed). Production use managing other businesses' ad accounts requires ads_management permission via Meta App Review plus Business Verification (Advanced Access), which is an approval gate rather than a paid tier. No official Meta-published MCP server found; several community MCP servers exist (e.g. pipeboard-co/meta-ads-mcp). API is REST over graph.facebook.com with hundreds of endpoints/fields across campaigns, ad sets, ads, creatives, audiences, catalogs, and insights.
